content_review.reviewer: Codex exact-taxon source, bilingual, range and image-risk audit
content_review.notes: Every English and Chinese section was compared line by line. Accepted species identity, IUCN scope, numeric claims, map generalization and look-alike image risks were checked against the cited sources. Generalized polygons do not imply continuous occupancy.

conservation_status.note_en: The species-level global category checked on 2026-11-12 is Least Concern; regional and legal listings may differ.
conservation_status.note_zh: 已于2026-11-12核对物种级全球等级为无危；地区和法律名录可能不同。

description.en: The Sunbittern is a slender streamside bird of tropical America. Its closed wings look cryptically brown, but a threat display suddenly reveals large orange, chestnut, black and white eyespots across both wings.
description.zh: 日鳽是热带美洲溪边的纤细鸟类。合翼时呈隐蔽褐色，威吓时却会突然展开双翼，露出橙、栗、黑、白相间的大型眼斑。

anatomy.en: Adults have long legs, a slender neck, a straight pointed bill and soft barred plumage. Red eyes are bordered by facial stripes; the spread wings expose bright semicircular patches that are hidden at rest.
anatomy.zh: 成鸟腿长、颈细、喙直而尖，被羽柔软且有横纹。红眼周围有面纹；展开的翅露出鲜艳半圆斑，休息时完全隐藏。

ecology_and_behavior.en: Usually solitary or paired, Sunbitterns walk slowly along shaded streams and forest pools, taking insects, crustaceans, small fishes, frogs and other small animals. They fly to trees when alarmed.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 日鳽通常单独或成对，在阴湿溪流和森林水池边缓慢行走，捕食昆虫、甲壳动物、小鱼、蛙等小动物；受惊时会飞上树。

habitat_and_distribution.en: Patchily distributed from southern Mexico and Guatemala through Central America into northern and central South America, especially wooded banks of streams, creeks and forest wetlands.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 斑块状分布于墨西哥南部和危地马拉，经中美洲延伸至南美洲北部和中部，尤其栖息在林木覆盖的溪流、沟渠及森林湿地岸边。

life_cycle_and_reproduction.en: A pair builds a shallow cup of sticks, mud and decaying vegetation about 3–6 m above ground. Both adults incubate 2–3 eggs for about 28 days and feed and defend the chicks.
life_cycle_and_reproduction.zh: 配偶在离地约3–6米处用枝条、泥和腐植物筑浅杯巢。双亲共同孵育2–3枚卵约28天，并喂养和保护雏鸟。

detail.en: Sudden exposure of high-contrast patches startles or redirects an approaching threat.
detail.zh: 突然露出高对比斑块，可惊吓或转移逼近的威胁。

detail.en: Long legs, neck and pointed bill support precise strikes in shallow water and leaf litter.
detail.zh: 长腿、长颈和尖喙适合在浅水与落叶层精确出击。

detail.en: Fine brown barring blends with branches, stones and dappled shade when the display is folded away.
detail.zh: 展示斑收起后，细密褐纹融入枝条、石块和斑驳阴影。

ecological_role.en: It is a small predator connecting stream invertebrates, fishes and amphibians with larger forest predators. Nest materials and prey movement also link riparian water and vegetation.
ecological_role.zh: 它是小型捕食者，把溪流无脊椎动物、鱼和两栖类与更大型森林捕食者联系起来；筑巢材料和猎物移动也连接河岸水体与植被。

threats.en: Globally Least Concern but decreasing. Clearing and degradation of wooded stream corridors, pollution, damming and disturbance near nests reduce local habitat quality.
threats.zh: 全球为无危但正在下降。林木溪流廊道砍伐与退化、污染、筑坝及巢区干扰会降低局地生境质量。

actions.en: Protect continuous shaded riparian vegetation, maintain natural stream flow and clean water, prevent disturbance around active nests and include narrow forest waterways in land-use planning.
actions.zh: 应保护连续阴湿河岸植被，维持自然水流和清洁水质，避免干扰活动巢，并在土地规划中纳入狭窄森林水道。

key_features.en: A heronlike brown bird with a red eye, bold black-and-white face stripes, fine barred body and long orange legs. Spread wings reveal huge orange-chestnut and black eyespot patterns.
key_features.zh: 似鹭的褐色鸟，红眼、醒目黑白面纹、细密横斑身体和橙色长腿；展翅时露出巨大橙栗与黑色眼斑。

similar_species.en: Juvenile herons may share a streamside posture but lack the Sunbittern's facial pattern and hidden wing eyespots. The Kagu is a pale New Caledonian relative with a crest and completely different range.
similar_species.zh: 幼鹭可能有相似溪边姿态，但没有日鳽的面纹和隐藏翼眼斑。鹭鹤是新喀里多尼亚浅色近亲，有冠羽且分布完全不同。

communication_and_senses.en: Sharp vision guides slow stalking and rapid bill strikes. Calls maintain pair contact along noisy streams, while wing and tail displays provide strong visual warnings.
communication_and_senses.zh: 敏锐视觉引导缓慢潜行和快速喙击；叫声帮助配偶在嘈杂溪流旁联络，翅尾展示则提供强烈视觉警告。

seasonal_calendar.en: Breeding varies with regional rains and stream conditions across the broad range. Both parents remain closely tied to the nest through incubation and early chick care.
seasonal_calendar.zh: 在广阔分布区内，繁殖随地区降雨和溪流条件变化。孵卵和雏鸟早期，双亲都紧密守在巢区。

relationship_with_humans.en: Quiet observation from a distance can reveal natural stalking and display behavior. Approaching a nest can trigger a broken-wing distraction display and should be avoided.
relationship_with_humans.zh: 远距离安静观察可看到自然潜行和展示行为。接近巢穴可能触发假装折翼的诱敌展示，应当避免。

evolution.en: Sunbittern belongs to genus Eurypyga, family Eurypygidae, order Eurypygiformes. This record uses the accepted species-level binomial Eurypyga helias; facts and images are not transferred from close relatives.
evolution.zh: 日鳽归入日鳽属、日鳽科、日鳽目。本条目采用接受的物种级二名法Eurypyga helias；不会从近缘种移用事实或图片。

field_signs.en: Walk slowly beside shaded streams and listen for low calls. A disturbed adult may spread its wings toward the observer or perform a broken-wing display away from chicks.
field_signs.zh: 可沿阴湿溪流缓慢行走并听取低声鸣叫。受扰成鸟可能朝观察者展翅，或在远离雏鸟处表演假折翼。

text.en: Its spectacular wing eyespots are almost invisible when the wings are folded.
text.zh: 壮观的翼眼斑在合翼时几乎完全看不见。

text.en: Both parents incubate the eggs and care for the chicks.
text.zh: 双亲都会孵卵并照护雏鸟。

text.en: It is the only living species in family Eurypygidae.
text.zh: 它是日鳽科唯一的现生物种。

content.en: Adults can expose wing eyespots to appear larger or feign a broken wing to draw a predator away. The two displays solve different problems: intimidation and distraction.
content.zh: 成鸟可露出翼眼斑使自己显得更大，也可假装折翼把捕食者引离；两种展示分别解决威吓和转移注意的问题。

habitat.text_en: Patchily distributed from southern Mexico and Guatemala through Central America into northern and central South America, especially wooded banks of streams, creeks and forest wetlands.
habitat.text_zh: 斑块状分布于墨西哥南部和危地马拉，经中美洲延伸至南美洲北部和中部，尤其栖息在林木覆盖的溪流、沟渠及森林湿地岸边。

range_review.comparison_en: This new record has no previous geometry. The displayed nonrectangular polygons conservatively generalize the cited institutional distribution evidence for readable map display; boundaries are approximate and never imply continuous occupancy.
range_review.comparison_zh: 这是没有旧几何的新记录。显示的非矩形多边形依据所引机构分布证据作保守概化，以便地图清晰呈现；边界为近似范围，绝不表示圈内连续分布。
